services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: Come on down to the beach for an exciting excursion on one of our Jet Skis. All rentals are by the 1/2 hour or hour and we can seat up to 2-3 riders at a time. Jump some waves and have a blast from the best seat on Panama City Beach! Age requirements: Florida Law states that riders under the age of 14 years must be accompanied by an adult. License requirement: Jet Ski operators who were born on or after January 1, 1988, must complete a Boaters’ Safety Education Course. We offer a temporary certificate valid for one year to those who fall in this category. To take the Florida Boat Course Temporary Certificate Test - Click Here. Ready to take to the waves? That’s great! But first, we need you

services.name: Banana Boat Rides
services.desc: Enjoy a scenic and thrilling ride on one of our new banana boats! The boat will be guided by one of our experienced crew members and offers an exciting, fun way to explore the beauty of our famous Emerald Coast beaches. Leave the driving to us while you take in the breathtaking views and spot some of the beloved marine life that we are fortunate to share these beaches
